Verified Modal smoke task (2026-09-12)

This task directory is the recipe every compiled swesim task builds on. Each element was verified by a Harbor 0.23 run on Modal (job dirs were under /tmp/swesim/jobs; results summarized here):

  • [agent] user = "agent": agent runs unprivileged (uid 1001); it cannot remove a root-owned non-empty directory under agent-owned /app.
  • [environment] network_mode = "allowlist" (strict: model API + stakeholder host) is the baseline and governs setup and collection; [agent] uses the same strict list. api.anthropic.com reachable (401), github.com and example.com blocked. A Modal web endpoint hostname in the allowlist is reachable from the sandbox (HTTP 200) while github stays blocked.
  • Agent toolchain is pre-baked (system-wide uv, uv python install 3.12, uv tool install mini-swe-agent --with litellm --with orjson --with fastapi as user agent, then chown -R agent:agent /home/agent) with UV_OFFLINE=1 UV_NO_PROGRESS=1 UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/uv-cache in [environment.env], so Harbor's mini-swe-agent setup succeeds offline. Without pre-baking, setup fails with NetworkConnectionError even with package mirrors allowlisted (apt over HTTP is blocked on Modal).
  • Collection: [[verifier.collect]] runs root-owned tar of /app (excluding .git and .venv) to /logs/artifacts/app.tar plus a collect.status receipt. /logs/artifacts transfers reliably to the separate verifier. Harbor's directory artifacts (artifacts=[{source="/app", exclude=[...]}]) are NOT used: the host-side extraction aborts on absolute symlinks and silently truncates the tree.
  • Separate verifier (environment_mode = "separate", tests/Dockerfile) runs as root, offline; extracts app.tar member-by-member with tarfile.extract(filter="data") (absolute symlinks rejected); writes a numeric-only reward.json (multi-key accepted by Harbor).
  • mini-swe-agent 2.4.6 + anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 completed the task end to end: reward 1, ATIF trajectory at agent/trajectory.json, 1m29s.

Run (API keys exported in the shell first):

harbor run -p references/modal-smoke-task -a mini-swe-agent -m anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 -e modal --jobs-dir jobs --yes
harbor run -p references/modal-smoke-task -a oracle -e modal --jobs-dir jobs --yes

stakeholder_probe_app.py is the Modal web endpoint used for the host reachability probe (modal deploy stakeholder_probe_app.py).
